phases.title: Baseline Diagnostic and Gap Identification
phases.objective: Assess learner's baseline across DSA, C#/.NET, SQL, frontend, system design, debugging, FDE, and communication.
phases.gate_criteria: Completion of baseline diagnostic across all 10 dimensions with initial competency matrix populated.

phases.title: Computer Science & Operating Systems Fundamentals
phases.objective: Master memory layouts, CPU cache hierarchies, processes, threads, virtual memory, networking protocols (TCP/TLS/HTTP).
phases.gate_criteria: Explain OS scheduling and memory management from first principles; build a socket/protocol simulator.

phases.title: Data Structures & Algorithmic Problem Solving (DSA)
phases.objective: Master 26 core algorithmic patterns in C# under interview constraints.
phases.gate_criteria: Solve unseen LeetCode medium problems independently within 25 minutes with formal complexity proofs.

phases.title: Advanced C# & .NET Runtime Internals
phases.objective: Master CLR execution, JIT, GC generation mechanics, Span<T>, ValueTask, async state machines, memory profiling.
phases.gate_criteria: Demonstrate zero-allocation parsers, diagnose memory leaks, explain thread pool work-stealing.

phases.title: ASP.NET Core Backend Architecture
phases.objective: Build high-throughput, resilient backend services using Minimal APIs, middleware, authentication, and DI best practices.
phases.gate_criteria: Design and build a production-grade resilient modular service with integration test suite.

phases.title: Entity Framework Core & Database Engineering
phases.objective: Master relational database indexing, execution plan analysis, transaction isolation, deadlocks, and EF Core mechanics.
phases.gate_criteria: Optimize slow queries using index strategies, solve N+1 traps, design concurrency conflict handlers.

phases.title: Modern Frontend Engineering (Angular & React)
phases.objective: Deep-dive Angular (Signals, RxJS, DI) and React (Hooks, reconciliation, state management) as rigorous software disciplines.
phases.gate_criteria: Build accessible, performant component workflows with deterministic state management and testing.

phases.title: Full-Stack Architecture & Delivery
phases.objective: End-to-end integration between modern SPAs and .NET backends with auth contracts, error boundaries, and observability.
phases.gate_criteria: Deliver an end-to-end multi-tier application with automated end-to-end tests.

phases.title: Low-Level Design (LLD) & High-Level System Design (HLD)
phases.objective: Design scalable architectures with back-of-the-envelope capacity estimations, trade-off analysis, and fault tolerance.
phases.gate_criteria: Successfully complete mock system design interviews for high-scale distributed platforms.

phases.title: Distributed Systems, Cloud & Site Reliability (SRE)
phases.objective: Master consensus, partitioning, replication, OpenTelemetry tracing, SLO/SLI budgets, and production incident response.
phases.gate_criteria: Diagnose simulated distributed deadlocks and network partitions; execute blue/green rollbacks.

phases.title: Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) & Customer Problem Solving
phases.objective: Navigate ambiguous client requirements, enterprise identity, legacy network boundaries, and rapid prototyping.
phases.gate_criteria: Deliver a complete customer solution proposal, integration prototype, runbook, and handover artifact.

phases.title: Agentic AI Systems Engineering
phases.objective: Build production-grade AI agent systems: tool calling, typed planning, memory graphs, prompt defense, and eval metrics.
phases.gate_criteria: Implement and evaluate an autonomous multi-agent system with typed tools and safety guardrails.

phases.title: Staff/Principal Engineering & Technical Leadership
phases.objective: Demonstrate executive communication, cross-team technical governance, RFC writing, and staff-level interview excellence.
phases.gate_criteria: Score Advanced/Mastered across senior/staff interview simulations and publish an architectural RFC.
